intro.zh: 东南大学机械工程学院机械工程博士生，研究眼动交互与 AR/VR 中的目标选择、交互设计及用户体验。导师：牛亚峰教授。
intro.en: PhD student in Mechanical Engineering at Southeast University, supervised by Prof. Yafeng Niu. My research examines gaze interaction, target selection, and user experience in AR/VR.

detail.zh: GPA 3.9/4.0，专业排名 1/36；另修数据科学与大数据技术双学位。
detail.en: GPA 3.9/4.0, ranked 1/36; additional degree in Data Science and Big Data Technology.

description.en: Design and evaluate gaze, blink, smooth-pursuit, and multimodal interaction methods; build experimental systems with HoloLens 2, Unity, and eye trackers.
